record.title: Jhulaghat bridge closure for Indian local elections, October 2019
record.scope: Ordinary crossing of the Jhulaghat international suspension bridge
record.crossings: Jhulaghat bridge over the Kali/Mahakali River
record.movement: Ordinary people crossing the bridge; cargo not separately disaggregated
record.exceptions: Emergency passage could be agreed by the two administrations.
record.imposing_authority: Indian district election authorities and Nepal's Baitadi administration
record.enforcement: Indian-side contemporary report confirms the bridge had been shut; later Nepali report recalls the October 3–5 closure.
record.relationship: Separate from Parsa May 2019 and later Darchula/November proposals. RSS reprints are one report, not corroboration.
record.status_observation: Evidence is limited to the reported episode; no present-day status is inferred.
record.official_rationale: Security for October 5 Panchayat voting in adjacent Pithoragarh development blocks.
record.context: A bounded international river-bridge closure; separate from later phases at Darchula.
record.uncertainty: Nepali officials scheduled October 3 at 17:00 through October 5 at 17:00, while Indian district reporting gives early October 6. Actual reopening was not observed. The phase therefore preserves scheduled endpoint bounds, with discretionary emergency passage.

historical.duration_note: Scheduled or ordered reopening; actual operational duration not established. Implementation verified, but exact operational reopening and emergency passage remain unresolved.
